_note: DOS CGA Phantasie III art (s160; tools/scripts/extract_dos_p3_graphics.py, importer P3Dos/P3CgaArt.cs; formats in reverse-engineering/dos/phantasie3/FORMAT.md section 10). Two CGA palettes, high intensity [~] (DOSBox colours): every file is cut in palette 0; s169: the screens DOS shows in palette 1 (0x284:0xaaf) are recoloured index for index (scene_palettes). Never the default (auto_select false): drawn when no Amiga III pack is present (index fallback_order, a DOS-only import) or when chosen. Screens: TOWN.CMP, PICS.CMP (title, Astral Plane, Zeus, Pluto). Overworld: WORLD.CGA's 250 tiles of 16x16, tile = map byte, a 9x9 view (ovl3 0x12f1); the party's cell draws tile 89 instead of the map tile (overworld.party, opaque). tile_swaps: while on Scandor (region 0) ovl3 0x0 draws six tiles as others. Dungeon: SHAPES.CGA's 8x5 glyphs 46..52 with the cell map of ovl4 0x21bb (the Amiga's numbers). Monsters by DOS's own picture choice (root 0x10b8b: byte 27, minus 1 above 27; an index past the giants shows picture 15), except D3-067 (user s161): Wolf, Mud Elemental and Troll Baby borrow an analogous creature's picture as the Amiga pack does (Wild Dog, the party elemental, the party Troll; DOS: Skeleton, Skeleton, Forest Elf). Party pictures by race (DS:0x9ea), the elemental 22, the grave 24. Body figure: root 0xdcf, four sets (Okay green, Injured yellow, Broken red, Gone black). Scroll IV (item 126): the map of Scandor on the text page. s169: SHAPES.CGA's first two blocks are the flash (frame24, root 0x1537, drawn as DOS's OR blit: blend 'or', s170) and the text page's frame (glyph8, root 0x4a3). No buttons or windows: DOS has none of these pictures. Every other picture is opaque (DOS blits copy colour 0).
name: DOS (CGA)

scene_palettes._note: s169 [C] (FORMAT.md section 10, 'Palette per screen'): 0x284:0xaaf(n) selects CGA palette n. 1 on the dungeon map (ovl4 0x7dd, 0xc5d, 0x147a), a plane's map (root 0x79e: the plane FAR 0xcc4 not 0; Scandor 0), the fight's field (root 0x1080a; the orders screen 0xf9ca is 0), the gods' intro and picture (ovl4 0x3e; the speech's text page is 0) and the Astral Plane (root 0x1eba: all its lines, the three intro lines and one per member; s170 [C]: after the last member's line and its wait 0x452(200) DOS clears the screen (0x3b2:0x50c) and only then sets palette 0 (0x240c), so no line shows in palette 0 and the next screen, the town, is in 0, as the remaster's scene ends). 0 everywhere else: title, town, Scandor, the text pages (root 0x4a3).

tile_maps._tile_swaps: [region, map byte, tile drawn]: ovl3 0x0 swaps these while the plane (FAR 0xcc4) is 0, Scandor [C] (FORMAT.md section 10).
tile_maps._view_counters: s169 [C] (FORMAT.md section 10, 'Overworld view'): the size words FAR 0x97c8 (columns) / 0xcce (rows) the view ovl3 0x12f1 and its steps run on, as root 0x125d sets them: Scandor 50 x 74 (also the start-up, ovl1 0x873), the Netherworld 31 x 15, the Light and Dark planes 9 x 8 (no effect on a 9 x 9 map: the whole plane shows).
tile_maps._view_centre_margin: s170 [C] (FORMAT.md section 10, 'View size and edges'): the steps stop the view's centre at rows - 4 (north ovl3 0x13ac, south 0x1470) but at columns - 5 (west 0x154e, east 0x1612); the Amiga stops it at counter - 4 on both. So DOS's Scandor view ends at columns 41-49 and rows 66-74, the Netherworld's at columns 22-30 and rows 7-15: the view reads byte y * columns + x unchecked but never reaches a byte past a map.

town_screen._note: s169 [C] root 0xa9e2: twelve spaces at text cell (14, 2) in colour 3 on 3, then the town's name (string 111 + town) at cell 14 + ((12 - length) >> 1), row 2 (y 16), colour 0 on 3: centred in the 12 cells, an odd gap half a cell left ('Pendragon' at x 120, as the DOS shot s143_entry_done_town). Row 0-7 is the menu bar.

body_figure._note: root 0xdcf: 3 x 4 cells of 8x8; set s of stored piece p at SHAPES.CGA 0x3c40 + 192 s + 16 p, drawn at cell (p div 4, p mod 4). Draw order and areas: head 4, right arm 1 (the viewer's left), chest 5 (always Okay), left arm 9, right leg 2 and 3, torso 6, left leg 10 and 11; file body/<9 s + i> for the i-th piece below. Gone draws its black set (not a clear).

scroll_frame._note: s169 [C] the text page, root 0x4a3 (FORMAT.md section 10): palette 0; the whole screen in colour 3 (window DS:0x5c8) or the fill (8,8)-(311,191) inclusive in colour 3; the frame (the first page only) of SHAPES.CGA's 8x8 glyphs: corners 0 / 1 at the top, 3 / 2 at the bottom (y 192); top 4 + (rnd and 2), right (column 39) 12 + (rnd and 2), bottom 7 + (rnd and 1), left 9 + (rnd and 2), so 5, 10 and 13 are never drawn; the text from cell (1, 1) in colour 0. Scroll pages (0x32f), the dungeon's event page (ovl4 0x1c91: its key prompt at cell (14, 23)), the god's speech (ovl4 0x1a5) and Scroll IV (0x16a: the map at (96, 8); its caption, the literal DS:0x2699, at cell (10, 23) in colour 2 on 3, root 0x1b4: picture_caption).

reward_scene._note: s169 [C] the gods' reward, ovl4 0x0000 (FORMAT.md section 10): palette 1 (0x3e); the first intro line (DS:0x61a1) at cell (0, 11), then 0x396(1): 50 flashes 0x1537 at x = rnd mod 36 (+ rnd mod 3, at most 36) bytes, y = rnd mod 120 (+ 6 + rnd mod 22); frames 0, 1, 2 ORed over each other and onto the screen (blend 'or', 0x284:0x19c), each followed by the wait 0x452(w); w starts at 7 (0x4a) and goes 1 down every 5 flashes (from flash 0) to 1; then the second (DS:0x61c9) at (0, 9) and 0x396(0): w 1 up every 5 to 8. 0x452(w) waits max(1, floor(100 w / 60)) units of 10 ms (FAR 0xdd94 calibrated on the BIOS tick): w / 60 s here (vbl_hz 60, no extra VBL; DOS rounds down to 10 ms) [~]. The PC speaker's tone 0x66 before frame 1 is not played (no DOS sound in the pack). Then Zeus (argument good) or Pluto from PICS.CMP, the party, a key; the speech on the text page (palette 0).

combat_flash._note: s169 [C] the flash 0x1537 in a fight (FORMAT.md section 10): damage_monster (root 0xb14c) on the monster hit when its flag is set, at the group's field x (+0x3c + 2 i), y (+0x46), giant (+0x48); damage_character (0xbca4) on the member when its flag is set, at (6 slot, 140, 1). x += rnd mod 3 (+ 2 giant / member), at most 36 bytes; y += 6 + rnd mod 22; frames ORed onto the screen (blend 'or', 0x284:0x19c: colour 0 leaves it as it is, the others OR into what lies under), each followed by 0x452(6) = 100 ms (the wait word FAR 0xb5e8 is 6 in a fight; set back to 6 after the reward scene). The callers and their flags are the Amiga's (0x1833e / 0x17e16). The portraits' tops by rank are the remaster field's (the Amiga's 0x1b42e) [~]. No sound (the PC speaker's 0x66 is not played).
